# AgentContextKit 0.2.2 — extended context

AgentContextKit (ACKit) is an offline-first deterministic toolkit for agent-ready repositories. Canonical source: https://github.com/Cynrath/agent-context-kit

## Runtime and package

- Package: @cynrath/agent-context-kit
- Version: 0.2.2
- Runtime: Node.js >=22
- Primary language: TypeScript
- License: MIT
- Documentation: https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/

## Core capabilities

- Agent Readiness: explainable 0–100 scoring, strict thresholds, baselines and comparisons.
- Instruction Graph v2: provider-aware scope, precedence, provenance, shadowing, duplicates and conflicts for Codex, Claude, Gemini, Copilot and shared instruction files.
- Provider Profiles and Context Packs: deterministic provider-aware selection with token budgets and file manifests.
- Rule / Policy Packs: machine-checkable repository rules.
- Optimize v2: evidence-backed instruction and context hygiene recommendations.
- Scan + SARIF: secrets, connection strings, entropy, absolute paths, CI pinning and redacted evidence.
- Task System: docs-first, single-active task workflow and completion gates.
- Dashboard and Diagnostics: local repository inspection and deterministic support bundles.
- MCP and SDK: local integrations for agents and programmatic tooling.
- VS Code and GitHub Action: editor and CI integration.

## Common commands

ackit init --dry-run
ackit readiness
ackit instructions --explain
ackit scan --ci
ackit policy check
ackit optimize --explain
ackit pack --profile codex --max-tokens 50000
ackit dashboard --port 0 --open
ackit diagnostics --json
ackit mcp serve
